3.0.0.title: Argus 3.0 — The Human Flourishing Operating System
3.0.0.intro: Argus 3.0 marks a monumental evolution: expanding from an elite media and study center into The Human Flourishing Operating System. Unlock the extraordinary in everyone through accessible knowledge, wisdom, health, opportunity, human connection, trust, and personalized guidance.

sections.heading: Vision Blueprint v1.0 & Governance
items: The 20 Ultimate Goals Registry categorized into Core, Growth, and Frontier missions.
The 12 Core Intelligence Engines with architecture tiering and strict human sovereignty safeguards.
4-Phase Evolution Roadmap: ARGUS NOW → LEARN & HEAL → LIFE → NETWORK.
8 North Star indicators tracking real-world freedom and capability outside the app.

sections.heading: Universal Accountability Engine
items: Universal 5-Step Loop: Commit → Plan → Verify → Diagnose → Adapt.
7 tailored persona profiles: Student, Aspirant, Doctor, Analyst, Founder, Parent, and Senior Citizen.
Accountability without guilt: isolates avoidance friction from resource deficits, illness, and conscious priority shifts.
Evidence-Backed Commitment Reliability Formula excluding advance renegotiations and medical recovery.
Universal Accountability Ledger: Personal, professional, and public tiers with strict UNESCO compliance banning citizen social scoring.

sections.heading: ARGUS TRUST & Anti-Corruption
items: Public Money Tracker: complete interactive audits of rural infrastructure projects connecting budgets, tenders, and lab tests.
Civic Service Navigator: statutory zero-fee transparency to eliminate middlemen, document checklists, and RTI channels.
Evidence Vault with SHA-256 cryptographic document timestamping.
Zero algorithmic guilt: all documentation deviations are flagged solely for human due process.

sections.heading: Life Evolution & Intelligence
items: ARGUS NOW: single-question dispatcher ('How are you, really?') with Care, Clarity, and Advance modes.
Life Evolution Engine: 6 Worthwhile Modes honoring intentional living and uncompulsive deliberate rest.
Knowledge Mesh: concept prerequisite trees from basic fractions to graduate AI with W3C RDF federation.
Opportunity Equalizer: Kolkata Class 6 pilot with bilingual offline discovery missions.
5-Tier Compute Pyramid: 88.3% cost reduction democratizing high-tier intelligence for every household.
